evidence: qmax_coverage measured the coverage twice, with two meanings of "measured": on the three principal planes through the origin, a voxel finite in the raw slice (web/src/llm/metrics/coverage.ts:57), for full_coverage_q, low_q_gap and per_plane, which the verdict read; and in 3D, a voxel measured, finite and non-zero (src/nebula3d/analysis/coverage.py:116), for raw_counts and suggested_band. A volume that stores zeros for unmeasured space, unmasked, read as fully measured to the box on the planes, so the reach-based verdict passed while its counts end inside the box; and the planes' full coverage stopped at the box face where the 3D shells of a box measured to its corners run on (the dev control on 81³: 6.44 against 10.85 Å⁻¹). The taper's reach was taken to be full coverage whenever the support was on (web/src/llm/tools/defs/qmax_coverage.ts:29), though the backend fits its window to its support, the volume's mask and finite voxels (src/nebula3d/pipeline.py:1527, src/nebula3d/analysis/delta_pdf.py:614), which on zeros stored unmasked holds every voxel, and never fits a separable window the page asks for (delta_pdf.py:1124).
proposed_fix: qmax_coverage reads the coverage from nebula3d.analysis.coverage alone, through either adapter (GET /api/volumes/{id}/coverage, the webbridge's volume_coverage_json): full_coverage_q is where the 3D |Q| shells stop holding counts in 95 % of their voxels, the edge's resolution the shells' width (q_step, served). The planes only show where: the figure opens on the first principal plane through the origin, and the result drops per_plane and low_q_gap (raw_counts gives the lower edges). The module also serves where the shells stop being fully measured (measured_q_max): the taper's reach is that edge, where the backend fits an auto or ellipsoid window; where the measured voxels run past the counts by more than a shell (zeros stored), the verdict says the taper cannot follow the counts, and its remedy is the |Q| band alone.

web/src/llm/__tests__/verdicts.test.ts (coverage: the reach past it, zeros stored past the counts; no shell fully measured)

No dev case stores zeros: the constructed volumes carry that case. Arm A on dev re-run before and after: 32 of 32 entries identical, 5 of 8 cases pass, as recorded. qmax_coverage's result on the synthetic crystal is 1,147 characters, from 2,135, and its definition 97 shorter; the worst local turn before compaction 45,197 estimated tokens, from 45,931, every pin within 5 %. The band as the remedy where zeros are stored follows the verdict's reach rule; whether a band at the counts' edges changes the transform is open (P4.5's note).

decision.by: the manager, on the user's delegation
decision.option: qmax_coverage reads the coverage Python measures, through both adapters; the planes only show where; the taper follows the measured voxels, not the counts
